verdict.rationale: JumpCloud offers APIs/PowerShell for bulk operations and mentions exporting directory events data via RESTful commands, suggesting some data portability, but there is no explicit documentation of a full account/data export in open formats or a 'leave and take your data' workflow. missing for 10: dedicated full data-export feature, explicit open-format guarantees, independent verification that all identity/device/event data can be extracted and used elsewhere.
